question: 统计每个客户拥有的在线设备数量，并按数量降序排列
expected_sql: SELECT cus.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(ne.CI_ID) AS online_count FROM t_bz_config_customer cus LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON cus.CUSTOMER_ID = ne.CUSTOMER_ID AND ne.IS_ONLINE = 1 GROUP BY cus.CUSTOMER_ID, cus.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY online_count DESC
sql_32b:
SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(ne.NE_ID) AS online_device_count
FROM t_bz_config_customer c
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = ne.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE ne.IS_ONLINE = 1
GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME
ORDER BY online_device_count DESC;
sql_moe:
SELECT 
    c.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    COUNT(e.CI_ID) AS online_device_count
FROM 
    t_bz_config_ci_ne_root e
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer c ON e.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE 
    e.IS_ONLINE = 1 
    AND e.IS_ACTIVE = 1 
    AND e.IS_DELETED = 0
GROUP BY 
    c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME
ORDER BY 
    online_device_count DESC;

question: 统计最近7天内，每个客户产生的严重告警数量
expected_sql: SELECT cus.CUSTOMER_NAME, COUNT(ev.EVENT_ID) AS severe_count FROM t_bz_config_customer cus JOIN event_history ev ON cus.CUSTOMER_ID = ev.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE ev.SEVERITY = 1 AND ev.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY cus.CUSTOMER_ID, cus.CUSTOMER_NAME
sql_32b:
SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID, 
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME, 
    COUNT(*) AS critical_alarm_count
FROM 
    event_history eh
WHERE 
    eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Critical' 
    AND eh.EVENT_TIME >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID, 
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME;
sql_moe:
SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS severe_alert_count
FROM 
    event_history eh
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer c ON eh.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE 
    eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
    AND eh.SEVERITY_NAME IN ('Critical', 'Major', 'Warning')
    AND eh.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME
ORDER BY 
    severe_alert_count DESC;

question: 查询上个月告警总数最多的前3个客户，并列出这些客户下所有在线设备的名称和IP地址
expected_sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_IP, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) AS total_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID AND n.IS_ONLINE = 1 WHERE c.CUSTOMER_NAME IN ('中国电信上海理想', '测试客户', '南京研发中心') GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, n.NE_IP ORDER BY total_alarms DESC LIMIT 3;
sql_32b:
SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, d.HOST_NAME, d.NE_IP
FROM (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, COUNT(*) AS alarm_count
    FROM event_history
    WHERE EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND EVENT_TIME < LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
) AS top_customers
JOIN event_history eh ON top_customers.CUSTOMER_ID = eh.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root d ON eh.NE_ID = d.NE_ID
WHERE d.IS_ONLINE = 1;

    WHERE e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
      AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01 00:00:00')
      AND e.EVENT_TIME < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY e.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME
    ORDER BY alarm_count DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
online_devices AS (
    SELECT 
        d.CUSTOMER_ID,
        d.HOST_NAME AS device_name,
        d.NE_IP AS ip_address
    FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root d
    WHERE d.IS_ONLINE = 1
)

    od.device_name,
    od.ip_address
FROM alarm_counts ac
INNER JOIN online_devices od ON ac.CUSTOMER_ID = od.CUSTOMER_ID
ORDER BY ac.alarm_count DESC, od.device_name;

question: 找出上个月平均每天告警次数超过3次的客户，并列出这些客户下所有设备的名称
expected_sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, COUNT(e.EVENT_ID)/DAY(LAST_DAY(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))) AS avg_daily_alarms FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME HAVING avg_daily_alarms > 3 ORDER BY avg_daily_alarms DESC;
sql_32b:
SELECT DISTINCT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, d.HOST_NAME
FROM (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM event_history
    WHERE EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
      AND EVENT_TIME < DATE_FORMAT(NOW() ,'%Y-%m-01')
      AND EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING AVG(COUNT(EVENT_ID)) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID) > 3
) AS high_alert_customers
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root d ON high_alert_customers.CUSTOMER_ID = d.CUSTOMER_ID
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON high_alert_customers.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID;
sql_moe:
SELECT DISTINCT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, t.NE_NAME
FROM event_history e
JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root t ON e.NE_ID = t.NE_ID
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON e.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
  AND e.EVENT_TIME < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')
  AND e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, t.NE_NAME
HAVING COUNT(e.EVENT_ID) / DATEDIFF(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) > 3
ORDER BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, t.NE_NAME;

question: 找出本月告警恢复平均时间最长的前5个设备，并显示其所属客户和平均恢复时间（分钟）
expected_sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.EVENT_TIME, e.RECOVER_TIME)) AS avg_recover_minutes FROM t_bz_config_customer c INNER JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = n.CUSTOMER_ID INNER JOIN event_history e ON n.NE_ID = e.NE_ID WHERE YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) AND e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 AND e.RECOVER_TIME IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, n.HOST_NAME ORDER BY avg_recover_minutes DESC LIMIT 5;
sql_32b:
SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME AS 客户名称,
    eh.ROOT_NE_NAME AS 设备名称,
    AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, eh.EVENT_TIME, eh.ACK_TIME)) AS 平均恢复时间_分钟
FROM 
    event_history eh
WHERE 
    eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm' 
    AND eh.ACK_TIME IS NOT NULL
    AND YEAR(eh.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE())
    AND MONTH(eh.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE())
GROUP BY 
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME
ORDER BY 
    平均恢复时间_分钟 DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: 统计本月每个客户下，处于活动状态的告警数量与已恢复告警数量的比值
expected_sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_alarms, SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recovered_alarms, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2) END AS active_to_recovered_ratio FROM t_bz_config_customer c LEFT JOIN event_history e ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID AND YEAR(e.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(e.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) LEFT JOIN t_bz_config_ci_ne_root n ON e.NE_ID = n.NE_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME HAVING active_alarms > 0 OR recovered_alarms > 0;
sql_32b:
SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SUM(CASE WHEN eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm' AND YEAR(eh.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(eh.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_alarm_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'normal' AND YEAR(eh.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(eh.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recovered_alarm_count,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm' AND YEAR(eh.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(eh.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'normal' AND YEAR(eh.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(eh.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS alarm_ratio
FROM 
    event_history eh
WHERE 
    YEAR(eh.EVENT_TIME) = YEAR(CURDATE()) AND MONTH(eh.EVENT_TIME) = MONTH(CURDATE())
GROUP BY 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID, eh.CUSTOMER_NAME;
sql_moe:
SELECT 
    e.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_alarm_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recovered_alarm_count,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    END AS ratio_recovered_to_active
FROM

JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer c ON e.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE 
    e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01')

    AND e.EVENT_STATUS_NAME IN ('alarm', 'normal')
GROUP BY 
    e.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME
ORDER BY

expected_sql: WITH ping_events AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, LAG(e.EVENT_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) AS prev_time FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event'), durations AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, MAX(DATEDIFF(EVENT_TIME, prev_time)) AS max_duration_days FROM ping_events WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, max_duration_days FROM durations WHERE max_duration_days = (SELECT MAX(max_duration_days) FROM durations d2 WHERE d2.CUSTOMER_NAME = durations.CUSTOMER_NAME)
sql_32b:
SELECT 
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    eh.ROOT_NE_NAME AS DEVICE_NAME,
    MAX(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, eh.EVENT_TIME, COALESCE(eh_next.EVENT_TIME, NOW()))) AS MAX_CONTINUOUS_DAYS
FROM 
    event_history eh
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ROOT_NE_ID = ne.NE_ID
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer c ON ne.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
LEFT JOIN 
    event_history eh_next ON eh.ROOT_NE_ID = eh_next.ROOT_NE_ID 
    AND eh.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' 
    AND eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm' 
    AND eh_next.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' 
    AND eh_next.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'normal' 
    AND eh.EVENT_TIME < eh_next.EVENT_TIME
WHERE 
    eh.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' 
    AND eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
    AND ne.IS_ONLINE = 1
GROUP BY 
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME
ORDER BY 
    MAX_CONTINUOUS_DAYS DESC;
sql_moe:
WITH ping_events AS (
    SELECT 
        eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
        eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
        eh.ROOT_NE_NAME AS DEVICE_NAME,
        eh.EVENT_TIME AS ALARM_TIME,
        eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME,
        LAG(eh.EVENT_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY eh.CUSTOMER_ID, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME ORDER BY eh.EVENT_TIME) AS PREV_ALARM_TIME
    FROM event_history eh
    WHERE eh.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event'
      AND eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 
          FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root nc 
          WHERE nc.NE_ID = eh.NE_ID 
            AND nc.IS_ONLINE = 1
      )
),
continuous_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        CUSTOMER_NAME,
        DEVICE_NAME,
        ALARM_TIME,
        PREV_ALARM_TIME,
        CASE 
            WHEN PREV_ALARM_TIME IS NULL OR ALARM_TIME - PREV_ALARM_TIME > INTERVAL 1 MINUTE THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS new_period_flag
    FROM ping_events
),
period_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        CUSTOMER_NAME,
        DEVICE_NAME,
        ALARM_TIME,
        SUM(new_period_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID, DEVICE_NAME ORDER BY ALARM_TIME) AS period_group
    FROM continuous_periods
),
period_durations AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        CUSTOMER_NAME,
        DEVICE_NAME,
        MIN(ALARM_TIME) AS start_time,
        MAX(ALARM_TIME) AS end_time,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(ALARM_TIME), MIN(ALARM_TIME)) AS duration_days
    FROM period_groups
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID, CUSTOMER_NAME, DEVICE_NAME, period_group
),
ranked_devices AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        CUSTOMER_NAME,
        DEVICE_NAME,
        duration_days,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY duration_days DESC) AS rn
    FROM period_durations
)
SELECT 
    CUSTOMER_NAME,
    DEVICE_NAME,
    duration_days AS max_duration_days
FROM ranked_devices
WHERE rn = 1;

question: 找出每个客户在过去24小时内告警频率最高的设备（告警次数/在线时长），假设在线时长从最早告警时间计算
expected_sql: SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS alert_count, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME), MAX(e.EVENT_TIME)) AS hours_span, ROUND(COUNT(*) / NULLIF(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(e.EVENT_TIME), MAX(e.EVENT_TIME)), 0), 2) AS alerts_per_hour FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE r.IS_ONLINE = 1 AND e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.NE_ID, r.HOST_NAME ORDER BY alerts_per_hour DESC
sql_32b:
SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    eh.ROOT_NE_ID,
    eh.ROOT_NE_NAME,
    COUNT(eh.EVENT_ID) / TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MIN(eh.EVENT_TIME), NOW()) AS alarm_frequency
FROM 
    event_history eh
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ROOT_NE_ID = ne.NE_ID
WHERE 
    eh.EVENT_TIME >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR
    AND ne.IS_ONLINE = 1
GROUP BY 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID, eh.CUSTOMER_NAME, eh.ROOT_NE_ID, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME
ORDER BY 
    alarm_frequency DESC;
sql_moe:
WITH alarm_events AS (
    SELECT 
        eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
        eh.ROOT_NE_NAME AS device_name,
        eh.ADDRESS AS device_ip,
        eh.EVENT_TIME,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY eh.CUSTOMER_ID, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME ORDER BY eh.EVENT_TIME) AS rn
    FROM event_history eh
    WHERE eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
      AND eh.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
),
device_online_start AS (
    SELECT 
        ce.CUSTOMER_ID,
        ce.device_name,
        MIN(ce.EVENT_TIME) AS first_alarm_time
    FROM alarm_events ce
    GROUP BY ce.CUSTOMER_ID, ce.device_name
),
device_duration AS (
    SELECT 
        do.CUSTOMER_ID,
        do.device_name,
        do.first_alarm_time,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, do.first_alarm_time, NOW()) AS online_duration_seconds
    FROM device_online_start do
),
alarm_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
        eh.ROOT_NE_NAME AS device_name,
        COUNT(*) AS alarm_count
    FROM event_history eh
    WHERE eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
      AND eh.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
    GROUP BY eh.CUSTOMER_ID, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME
),
device_alarm_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        ac.CUSTOMER_ID,
        ac.device_name,
        ac.alarm_count,
        COALESCE(dd.online_duration_seconds, 0) AS online_duration_seconds,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(dd.online_duration_seconds, 0) = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE ac.alarm_count / dd.online_duration_seconds 
        END AS alarm_rate_per_second
    FROM alarm_counts ac
    LEFT JOIN device_duration dd 
        ON ac.CUSTOMER_ID = dd.CUSTOMER_ID 
       AND ac.device_name = dd.device_name
),
ranked_devices AS (
    SELECT 
        dar.CUSTOMER_ID,
        dar.device_name,
        dar.alarm_rate_per_second,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dar.CUSTOMER_ID ORDER BY dar.alarm_rate_per_second DESC) AS rank_order
    FROM device_alarm_rate dar
)
SELECT 
    rd.CUSTOMER_ID,
    c.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    rd.device_name,
    rd.alarm_rate_per_second
FROM ranked_devices rd
JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON rd.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
WHERE rd.rank_order = 1
ORDER BY rd.CUSTOMER_ID;

question: 查询每个客户不同类型告警（EVENT_TYPE_NAME）的分布比例，并找出'Ping event'占比超过30%的客户
expected_sql: WITH event_totals AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME), customer_totals AS (SELECT CUSTOMER_ID, SUM(type_count) AS total_alerts FROM event_totals GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID) SELECT et.CUSTOMER_NAME, et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME, et.type_count, ROUND(et.type_count / ct.total_alerts * 100, 2) AS percentage FROM event_totals et JOIN customer_totals ct ON et.CUSTOMER_ID = ct.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND et.type_count / ct.total_alerts > 0.3
sql_32b:
SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME,
    COUNT(et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME) AS event_count,
    (COUNT(et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME) / SUM(COUNT(et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME)) OVER (PARTITION BY eh.CUSTOMER_ID)) * 100 AS distribution_percentage
FROM 
    event_history eh
JOIN 
    (SELECT DISTINCT EVENT_TYPE_NAME FROM event_history) et
ON 
    eh.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME
GROUP BY 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID, eh.CUSTOMER_NAME, et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME
HAVING 
    et.EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND distribution_percentage > 30;
sql_moe:
WITH customer_event_type_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        e.CUSTOMER_ID,
        e.CUSTOMER_NAME,
        e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count
    FROM event_history e
    GROUP BY e.CUSTOMER_ID, e.CUSTOMER_NAME, e.EVENT_TYPE_NAME
),
customer_total_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        CUSTOMER_NAME,

    EVENT_TYPE_NAME,
    ratio_percent
FROM customer_event_type_ratio
WHERE EVENT_TYPE_NAME = 'Ping event' AND ratio_percent > 30
ORDER BY ratio_percent DESC;

question: 查询每个客户在过去7天内，每小时告警数量的标准差，找出告警最不稳定的客户（标准差最大）
expected_sql: WITH hourly_counts AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE e.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY c.CUSTOMER_NAME, HOUR(e.EVENT_TIME)) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, ROUND(STDDEV(alert_count), 2) AS std_deviation FROM hourly_counts GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY std_deviation DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID, 
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME, 
    STDDEV(alarm_count) AS std_dev_alarm_count
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,

question: 找出每个客户中，告警严重程度（SEVERITY）从低到高升级的设备（例如从WARNING升级到CRITICAL），显示客户名、设备名、升级次数
expected_sql: WITH severity_ranks AS (SELECT c.CUSTOMER_NAME, r.HOST_NAME, e.EVENT_TIME, e.SEVERITY, CASE e.SEVERITY WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 1 WHEN 'MINOR' THEN 2 WHEN 'MAJOR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 END AS severity_rank, LAG(CASE e.SEVERITY WHEN 'WARNING' THEN 1 WHEN 'MINOR' THEN 2 WHEN 'MAJOR' THEN 3 WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 4 END) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NE_ID ORDER BY e.EVENT_TIME) AS prev_rank FROM t_bz_config_ci_ne_root r JOIN t_bz_config_customer c ON r.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN event_history e ON r.NE_ID = e.NE_ID AND r.CUSTOMER_ID = e.CUSTOMER_ID) SELECT CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME, COUNT(*) AS severity_escalations FROM severity_ranks WHERE prev_rank IS NOT NULL AND severity_rank > prev_rank GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, HOST_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
sql_32b:
SELECT 
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    eh.ROOT_NE_NAME AS DEVICE_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS UPGRADE_COUNT
FROM 
    event_history eh
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_ID,
        ROOT_NE_ID,
        LAG(SEVERITY_NAME) OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_ID, ROOT_NE_ID ORDER BY EVENT_TIME) AS PREV_SEVERITY,
        SEVERITY_NAME
    FROM 
        event_history
    WHERE 
        SEVERITY_NAME IN ('Warning', 'Critical')
) sub
ON 
    eh.CUSTOMER_ID = sub.CUSTOMER_ID
    AND eh.ROOT_NE_ID = sub.ROOT_NE_ID
    AND eh.SEVERITY_NAME = sub.SEVERITY_NAME
WHERE 
    sub.PREV_SEVERITY = 'Warning'
    AND sub.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Critical'
GROUP BY 
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME;
sql_moe:
WITH severity_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        CUSTOMER_NAME,
        ROOT_NE_NAME AS DEVICE_NAME,
        EVENT_TIME,
        SEVERITY_NAME,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUSTOMER_NAME, ROOT_NE_NAME ORDER BY EVENT_TIME) AS rn
    FROM event_history
    WHERE SEVERITY_NAME IN ('Normal', 'Warning', 'Critical', 'Minor', 'Major', 'Informational', 'Unknown', 'Symptom')
),
severity_upgrade AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.CUSTOMER_NAME,
        s1.DEVICE_NAME,
        s1.SEVERITY_NAME AS current_severity,
        s2.SEVERITY_NAME AS next_severity,
        s1.EVENT_TIME AS current_time,
        s2.EVENT_TIME AS next_time
    FROM severity_rank s1
    JOIN severity_rank s2 ON s1.CUSTOMER_NAME = s2.CUSTOMER_NAME 
        AND s1.DEVICE_NAME = s2.DEVICE_NAME 
        AND s1.rn = s2.rn - 1
    WHERE s1.SEVERITY_NAME IN ('Normal', 'Warning', 'Minor', 'Major', 'Informational', 'Unknown', 'Symptom')
      AND s2.SEVERITY_NAME IN ('Warning', 'Critical', 'Minor', 'Major', 'Informational', 'Unknown', 'Symptom')
      AND CASE 
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Normal' THEN 0
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Warning' THEN 1
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Minor' THEN 2
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Major' THEN 3
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Critical' THEN 4
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Informational' THEN 5
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Unknown' THEN 6
            WHEN s1.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Symptom' THEN 7
            ELSE 8
          END < 
          CASE 
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Normal' THEN 0
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Warning' THEN 1
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Minor' THEN 2
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Major' THEN 3
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Critical' THEN 4
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Informational' THEN 5
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Unknown' THEN 6
            WHEN s2.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Symptom' THEN 7
            ELSE 8
          END
)
SELECT 
    CUSTOMER_NAME,
    DEVICE_NAME,
    COUNT(*) AS upgrade_count
FROM severity_upgrade
GROUP BY CUSTOMER_NAME, DEVICE_NAME
ORDER BY CUSTOMER_NAME, DEVICE_NAME;

question: 查询每个客户在线设备的平均告警间隔时间（分钟），仅显示间隔时间小于30分钟的客户

question: 找出每个客户中，最近3天内告警数量呈上升趋势的设备（每天告警数递增）

question: 找出每个客户中，'Ping event'告警发生时间最密集的3小时时段（滑动窗口）

        eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
        eh.ROOT_NE_NAME,
        DATE_FORMAT(eh.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m') AS MONTH,
        COUNT(eh.EVENT_ID) AS ALERT_COUNT,
        LAG(COUNT(eh.EVENT_ID)) OVER (PARTITION BY eh.CUSTOMER_ID, eh.ROOT_NE_NAME ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(eh.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m')) AS PREV_ALERT_COUNT
    FROM 
        event_history eh
    WHERE 
        eh.EVENT_STATUS_NAME = 'alarm'
        AND eh.EVENT_TIME >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
    GROUP BY 
        eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
        eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
        eh.ROOT_NE_NAME,
        DATE_FORMAT(eh.EVENT_TIME, '%Y-%m')
) subquery
WHERE 
    PREV_ALERT_COUNT IS NOT NULL
    AND ALERT_COUNT > 0
    AND PREV_ALERT_COUNT > 0

    eh.CUSTOMER_ID,
    eh.CUSTOMER_NAME,
    eh.ROOT_NE_NAME

            ELSE (alarm_count - LAG(alarm_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, device_name ORDER BY month)) / LAG(alarm_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, device_name ORDER BY month)

    SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Unknown_COUNT,
    SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Symptom' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Symptom_COUNT,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
     SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
     SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +

     SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Minor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
     SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
     SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + 
     SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Symptom' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS Total_COUNT,
    -(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0))) +
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Warning' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0))) +
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Critical' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0))) +
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Informational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Informational' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0))) +
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Minor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Minor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0))) +
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Major' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0))) +
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0))) +
        (SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Symptom' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0) * LOG2(SUM(CASE WHEN eh.SEVERITY_NAME = 'Symptom' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(Total_COUNT, 0)))
    ) AS Entropy
FROM 
    event_history eh
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_ci_ne_root ne ON eh.ROOT_NE_ID = ne.NE_ID
JOIN 
    t_bz_config_customer c ON eh.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID

    c.CUSTOMER_NAME, ne.HOST_NAME;
